subject.title: fix: restore GitHub Copilot turns and account context limits

question: After the branch is refreshed and required gates are green, should OpenClaw adopt this shared credential-scoped model-rematerialization seam across normal runs, compaction, and image resolution?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and fixes a real bundled-provider regression, but it deliberately changes shared auth and model lifecycle behavior across several runtime paths and needs owner confirmation of that permanent boundary.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Accept the generic provider-gated seam once the exact merge result is green and owner review confirms non-Copilot providers retain current behavior.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Require a smaller ownership seam if owners do not want credential-scoped model metadata to become a generic provider capability.
